counterfactual_missing_items: asthma or eosinophilia expected for EGPA
decisive_items: bronchial wall thickening and numerous granular shadows
response.rationale: R8 integrates the broadest set of distinct raw findings: sinusitis, bronchiolocentric CT changes, lymphocytic/fibrotic biopsy changes, and cold agglutinin serology. R5 overlaps on sinusitis, CT, and biopsy but lacks the serologic clue; R7 omits CT and serology; R3/R4 rest mainly on imaging/function; R6 only uses remote TB and effusion; R2 lacks biopsy/serology; R1 lacks sinopulmonary imaging and serology. No candidate is fully specific, but R8 has the best composite raw-span coverage.

rejected.why: Has sinusitis and biopsy lymphocytosis but omits CT/serology and lacks sarcoid granulomas.
Only imaging-span support; does not account for sinusitis, biopsy pattern, or cold agglutinin.
Restricted to prior tuberculous pleurisy and current effusion; no sinusitis, bronchiolar biopsy, or serologic support.
Sinusitis and bronchial wall thickening are nonspecific; no bronchial dilatation, biopsy, or lab evidence is supplied.
Biopsy fibrosis is compatible but ignores sinusitis, CT granularity, and cold agglutinin.
Only nonspecific airflow limitation and imaging; lacks sinusitis, biopsy, and serologic evidence.
